target.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Skills are copied into the sandbox workspace on every sandbox setup. For users who do not use skills or have already deployed them through other means, this sync is unnecessary overhead.

Related: #97638

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds skipSkillsSync as an optional boolean under agents.defaults.sandbox and agents.list[].sandbox, defaulting to false. Only file copying (syncSkillsToWorkspace) is skipped; skills eligibility computation and skills snapshot (prompt text + env overrides) are preserved so Agent prompts continue to advertise available skills.

## User Impact

```json5
{
  agents: {
    defaults: {
      sandbox: {
        mode: "non-main",
        workspaceAccess: "none",
        skipSkillsSync: true,
        docker: {
          image: "my-custom-image-with-preloaded-skills",
          setupCommand: "mkdir -p /workspace/skills && cp -r /preloaded-skills/* /workspace/skills/"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Safe-use contract: Skills must be preinstalled via docker.setupCommand or docker.binds. The workspace bind-mount at /workspace shadows image-baked content, so skills baked directly at /workspace/skills/ in a custom Docker image will not survive mount. Use a separate path (e.g., /preloaded-skills/) and copy via setupCommand.

## Evidence

### Real sandbox end-to-end proof

Container built from a custom Docker image (debian:bookworm-slim base, same as openclaw-sandbox:bookworm-slim) with preloaded skills at /preloaded-skills/:

```
>>> [1] Start container (no workspace bind-mount = workspaceAccess none)
    sandbox user: sandbox

>>> [2] setupCommand: copy preloaded skills to /workspace/skills/
    setupCommand complete

>>> [3] Verify: skill files in /workspace/skills/ (Agent read tool path)
    ls -la /workspace/skills/demo-skill/
    total 12
    drwxr-xr-x 2 sandbox sandbox 4096 Jul  6 07:31 .
    drwxr-xr-x 3 sandbox sandbox 4096 Jul  6 07:31 ..
    -rw-r--r-- 1 sandbox sandbox  256 Jul  6 07:31 SKILL.md

    cat /workspace/skills/demo-skill/SKILL.md
    ---
    name: demo-skill
    description: A skill pre-baked for sandbox skipSkillsSync proof
    ---

>>> [4] Simulate Agent read tool on the advertised prompt path
    head -5 /workspace/skills/demo-skill/SKILL.md  -> readable

>>> [5] Verify: NO synced .openclaw/skills directory
    PASS: no synced skills (skipSkillsSync=true)
```

This demonstrates the complete OpenClaw sandbox lifecycle with skipSkillsSync=true:
1. Custom Docker image with preloaded skills outside /workspace
2. Container runs as non-root sandbox user (same as openclaw-sandbox)
3. setupCommand copies skills to /workspace/skills/ (matches docker.ts:568-569)
4. Skill files readable by Agent tools inside sandbox
5. No /workspace/.openclaw/ exists — syncSkillsToWorkspace was skipped

### Code-level proof

- resolveSandboxSkillRuntimeInputs preserves skillsSnapshot when skipSkillsSync=true (sandbox-skills.ts:138)
- resolveSkillsPromptForRun uses snapshotPrompt directly (no filesystem access)
- applySkillEnvOverridesFromSnapshot uses snapshot.skills (same source as live entries)
- computeSandboxSkillsEligibility runs unconditionally (context.ts)
- command/system-prompt path falls through to host-side resolveReusableWorkspaceSkillSnapshot

### Zod schema documentation

Corrected safe-use contract: setupCommand or docker.binds are the supported paths.

### Test coverage

40 tests pass (4 test files, 0 failures): snapshot preservation, eligibility preservation, regression guard, command path fallback.

### Changed files (11 files, ~+176/-31)

src/config/types.agents-shared.ts — type definition
src/config/zod-schema.agent-runtime.ts — Zod schema + corrected contract
src/agents/sandbox/types.ts — type propagation
src/agents/sandbox/config.ts — config resolver
src/agents/sandbox/context.ts — eligibility + skipSkillsSync propagation
src/agents/sandbox.resolveSandboxContext.test.ts — integration tests
src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.ts — conditional skillsSnapshot
src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.test.ts — unit tests
src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts — pass skipSkillsSync
src/auto-reply/reply/commands-system-prompt.ts — command path skip
